alex: heads-up: noticed steady VRAM growth on long-context qwen runs after enabling rope-rescale in MQA mode. p95 token latency drifts up after ~1200 tokens.
tess: repro? logs?
alex: repro attached — run a chat with qwen-13b-mqa, seq 8k, batch=1. KV pages accumulate instead of reusing; `kv_allocs` counter increments without matching frees.
mike: can you paste the profiler snapshot? did kernel fallback show up?
alex: flame link: https://perf.internal/redwood/flush/4567 and a short trace:
```
KV: alloc_pages +1024 @ 0x7f...  (slot 243)
KV: free_pages 0  (expected reclaim: 512)
Kernel: fallback cuBLAS->fusedGEMM at step 48
Batcher: small-batches->no-merge (latency-mode)
```
jin: interesting — kernel fallback could change page alignment and break the slab coalescer. saw something vaguely similar with Llama runs but not identical.
tess: try toggling `kv_compaction_threshold` 0.8 -> 0.55? that helped fragmentation in prior experiments.
alex: tried 0.55 locally; fragmentation reduced but p95 still drifts. suspect rope scaling interaction: token positions shift and create more unique KV slots (rope wrap) causing interleaved page writes.
mike: can you test with `--kernel-prefer=fast-gemm` to avoid fallback? also set `batch_merge_ms=10` to encourage larger batches.
alex: ran kernel-prefer + merge — p95 improved but memory growth persists at long-run (~10k tokens). key signal: `kv_page_age` histogram shows many young pages pinned ~3-5k steps.
infra-bot: deploy 4567890123 finished: rolled back model variant to qwen-13b-v2-compat
tess: may be a per-model hash salt: GQA vs MQA compute different hash for positional cache leading to different eviction buckets.
jin: good call — MQA reweights positions; our page coalescer bins by (model_id,pos_chunk). If pos wraps non-monotonic then coalescer fragments slots.
mike: hypothesis: during rope scaling we remap positions with modulo which spreads accesses across slab boundaries -> fragmentation + fewer reuses.
alex: attaching minimal repro instructions:
```
1) start server: `--kv-compaction-threshold=0.6 --kernel-prefer=fusedGEMM --batch_merge_ms=10`
2) run: `rb perf chat --model qwen-13b-mqa --seq 10000 --prompt-size 50`
3) sample `kv_alloc_map` every 500 tokens and dump `kv_page_age`
```
Anyone up for a 30m pairing to bisect the kernel change that landed last week? low-priority but boiling on staging.
tess: I'll join in 15. ping @mike too.
mike: on it. grabbing the bisect branch now.
alex: thx — if kernel remap is root we can add a compaction pass after rope-scaling to reserialize slots before slab coalesce.
jin: also add metric `kv_coalesce_success_rate` (reclaimed_bytes / scanned_bytes) + alert if < 0.5.
tess: agreed. I'll file a tiny follow-up PR for the metric and docs.
mike: quick note: forcing `kv_page_pin_ttl=2000` reduces churn but masks the root cause; prefer a real fix.
alex: agreed. leaving logs & repro in the incident gist: https://gist.internal/r/kv-rope-frag-4567
mike: adding a short runbook entry under 'kv/rope-fragmentation'
tess: :thumbsup:
